description: Estimate GPU energy for a token count from the best matching row, with kg CO2e for a grid and optional energy at the meter.

country.description: Country name, short name, ISO 3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code, or World

gpu.description: GPU name; omit to use the best row overall

itl_deadline_ms.description: Latency ceiling in milliseconds for choosing the best row (default 500)

num_gpus.description: Only configurations on exactly this many GPUs

output_tokens.description: Number of output tokens to price

pue.description: Power usage effectiveness, at least 1.0; enables energy at the meter

running_batch.description: Average running batch; the measured configuration nearest to it is used

system_power_ratio.description: Whole-system to GPU power ratio, at least 1.0; enables energy at the meter

name: estimate
